The description claims the green Confidence line starts at an Answer Popularity of 0, but the first data point is at an x-value of approximately 5.
The description claims the Confidence line falls to ~0.81 at x=40. However, the plot shows the value increases to approximately 0.84 at x=40.
The description claims the red Alignment line starts at an Answer Popularity of 0, but the first data point is at an x-value of approximately 5.
The description states that the Alignment line 'falls slightly' to ~0.55 at x=20. In the plot, the line increases from ~0.48 at x=10 to ~0.54 at x=20.
The description claims the Alignment line falls to ~0.59 at x=40. However, the plot shows the value increases to approximately 0.62 at x=40.
